title: On Concentrating every lamp in one room
subtitle: 习惯自律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）
meta: 主题语境：习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）　|　核心词汇：concentrate　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 concentrate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the elder ① concentrated every lamp in one room in the rain, and every youth in the village said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the elder ② concentrates every lamp in one room without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ concentrate every lamp in one room at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ concentrated every lamp in one room before — a line in the memoir for November 1972 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Concentrating every lamp in one room in the rain, the elder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far gate, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ concentrate on the work at hand without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Concentrate on the work at hand at once and never mention it again.

By 1985 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the memoir, and a new youth from the next village ⑧ concentrates on the work at hand in the rain every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the gate, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ concentrated every lamp in one room again when nobody else would.

⑩ To concentrate every lamp in one room, my mother said in 1990, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the village remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the village forgets, somebody concentrates every lamp in one room without complaint again and somebody must concentrate every lamp in one room in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 集中（一般过去式 concentrated every lamp in one room：1978 年长者头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 集中（一般现在 concentrates every lamp in one room：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 集中（不定式 to concentrate every lamp in one room：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 集中（过去完成时 had concentrated every lamp in one room：1972 年十一月的回忆录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 集中（动名词 concentrating every lamp in one room 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 专注于（concentrate on the work at hand：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去专注于专心做手上的活）
G. v. 专注于（concentrate on the work at hand：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 集中（后段两处：新来的后生照例 concentrates on the work at hand，而母亲又一次 concentrated every lamp in one room）

answers.why: concentrate 意为“集中”，1978 年长者淋着雨集中把所有的灯都聚在一间屋里，那是村子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 concentrated。
concentrate 意为“集中”，自那以后长者毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 concentrates。
concentrate 意为“集中”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯集中把所有的灯都聚在一间屋里”，此处为不定式 to concentrate every lamp in one room。
concentrate 意为“集中”，回忆录里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1985 年之前就有人集中过，故用过去完成时 had concentrated。
concentrate 意为“集中”，长者说“集中把所有的灯都聚在一间屋里这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 concentrating every lamp in one room 作主语。
concentrate 意为“专注于”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去专注于专心做手上的活”，should ever 之后用原形 concentrate on the work at hand。
concentrate 意为“专注于”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻专注于专心做手上的活（concentrate on the work at hand at once），以后再也不要提起。
concentrate 意为“集中”，新来的后生每个年头都照例专注于专心做手上的活，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 concentrates。
concentrate 意为“集中”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨集中把所有的灯都聚在一间屋里，用一般过去式 concentrated 叙述。
concentrate 意为“集中”，结尾那句是母亲 1990 年的话：要集中把所有的灯都聚在一间屋里，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和村子记住的那一件。

多年以后，长者仍毫无怨言地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（concentrates every lamp in one room）

长者说过，淋着雨集中把所有的灯都聚在一间屋里这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（concentrating every lamp in one room 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻专注于专心做手上的活，以后再也不要提起。（concentrate on the work at hand，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 concentrate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the elder concentrated every lamp in one room in the rain, and nobody in the village forgot it.
Even now the elder concentrates every lamp in one room without complaint whenever the village asks.
Concentrating every lamp in one room in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever concentrate on the work at hand without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new youth from the next village concentrates on the work at hand in the rain every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother concentrated every lamp in one room again, and the village remembered that half.
